column1: # The collision boxes of every block state, reported by the official 1.21.8 server through the external harness
# (circuit-harness 0.6.0 with its collision report, 2026-10-16), without an entity context: a block's name and its boxes
# when all its states have the same ones, otherwise each state with its boxes. Boxes are min x, y, z and max x, y, z in
# 1/32 block, separated by ';'; '-' is no collision. Offsets that some blocks apply by position are not included.
